@kamilbaranek_ cal ai

users are exploring, very unlikely on internal search engines. 

On enterprise systems users are trained and will tend to search for existing keywords. Most of the time they know what they are looking for, so vectors only add noise.

LLMs are also very good at query expansion (e.g adding the synonyms to the query, so you don't have to add them to the search engine). 

So as an expert user you can ask your agent to expand the query on certain ways.

Consider vectors if users ask questions instead of dropping keywords on the search bar, and be prepared to pay more, and see more noise in the search results. 

On an enterprise context is much easier to tune the system and train the people.

So:

Trained users/know what they want -> Synonyms, typo tolerance, query expansion.

Untrainted users/questions tokens not in the corpus -> consider vectors on top.
